checks.text: Selecting "E2" in the select labelled "String" and clicking the button "Play reference" causes the status text to read "Playing E2 at 82.41 Hz".
Clicking the button "Record sample" starts recording; after 2 seconds the button label changes to "Stop recording" and the elapsed time display shows "0:02".
After stopping the recording, the field labelled "Detected frequency" shows a value between 80 and 85 Hz, and the field labelled "Cent offset" shows a value between -50 and 50.
Clicking the button "Save to log" adds a row to the table labelled "Tuning log" that contains "E2", "82.41", and the detected frequency value from the previous step.
Clicking the button "Delete" on the last row of the "Tuning log" table removes that row, and if it was the only row the table shows "No entries yet".
Clicking the tab "History" shows a table labelled "Session history" with columns "Date", "String", "Target Hz", "Detected Hz", and "Cents".
Selecting "A4" in the select labelled "String" changes the status text to "Selected A4 at 440.00 Hz".
Reload keeps the row in the "Tuning log" table that contains "E2" and "82.41".
